rule: Stand-ins for the cell's missing Creation Club, Dawnguard and Hearthfire clutter (as KeebaHouseFisher). Each stand-in is a published piece of the same object class and near size, drawn at the missing reference's transform by worldgen/export_interior_bundle.py.

removals.search: settlement-kit-sourcing-log.md, the KotM stand-ins row of 2026-09-28 (lane L17): no published interior kit holds the same object; the piece lives only in a Creation Club, Dawnguard or Hearthfire archive, which the vault does not hold
removals.note: A redwort flower lies here; no kit holds one, so the spot stays bare.

removalRule: Owner ruling 2026-10-04 (R113): no missing piece ships as a gap. A missing piece takes a same-class stand-in from a published kit where one exists (substitutions[]); a decorative piece whose class no published kit or vault archive holds is taken out of the fit-out (removals[], reason decorative-no-same-class, its search recorded), and the spot is simply empty. A placed piece whose only support was a removed piece is removed with it (reason rests-on-a-removal, restsOn naming that row).
